title: Disciplinary Cleanup
description:
Once upon a time, in the magical land of Equestria... 
As part of a disciplinary punishment, the Royal Sisters were told to clean up after themselves. However, even such a tedious chore sisters can turn into a wild competition.
passedDescription: The Royal Sisters had a chance to clean up after themselves, but they didn't stand a chance of cleaning up the mess their mentor had made...
